fusions.name: Ward-Gnawer
fusions.desc: Sends a ward-gnawing rat at one enemy, dealing 32 damage that ignores its resistances.

fusions.name: Static in the Fur
fusions.desc: Static jumps from your swarm to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lap Up Spilt Mana
fusions.desc: Restores 25 mana to you, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Charge in the Coat
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack of static builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
